keyword: long distance concrete pump shortlist Xingtai

title.en: The Long-Distance Shortlist Names Four Xingtai Pages
title.zh: 长距离短名单点名邢台的四张页面

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai’s selection note starts long-distance buyers at Electric 80, then Electric 60, HBT8018 and Diesel 120. Each page keeps its own metres.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的选型说明让长距离买家先看电动80，再看电动60、HBT8018 和柴油120。每一页保留自己的米数。

h1.en: Shortlist the Four Long-Distance Rows, Then Pick One Path
h1.zh: 先短名单四条长距离行，再选定一条路径

directAnswer.en: For a long pipeline or a high vertical figure, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names a shortlist: Electric 80 (900 m / 300 m, 60 m³/h), then Electric 60, HBT8018 and Diesel 120. Electric 80 is the only page in that set with 900 m horizontal. Diesel 120 prints 150 m / 500 m and 100 m³/h on twin 145 kW engines. HBT8018 prints conveying 150 m and delivery height 450 m at 132 kW. Electric 60 prints fine-stone 200 m / 600 m at 90 kW. Send one path, not the whole shortlist as one machine, to the contact page.
directAnswer.zh: 管路很长或垂直数字很高时，河北品锦机械（邢台）点名一份短名单：电动80（900 m / 300 m、60 m³/h），然后是电动60、HBT8018 和柴油120。这一组里只有电动80有水平 900 m。柴油120印 150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h，双机各 145 kW。HBT8018 印输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、132 kW。电动60印细石 200 m / 600 m、90 kW。把一条路径发到询盘页，不要把整份短名单当成一台机器。

heading.en: Grid or diesel decides the half of the list
heading.zh: 电网或柴油决定名单的一半

body.en: Electric 80, Electric 60 and HBT8018 need the printed motors: 110 kW, 90 kW and 132 kW. Diesel 120 is the diesel row. A site that cannot feed 110 kW should not keep Electric 80 and drop the motor cell.
body.zh: 电动80、电动60和 HBT8018 需要所印电机：110 kW、90 kW 和 132 kW。柴油120是柴油行。带不住 110 kW 的现场，不应留下电动80却删掉电机格。

body.en: 900 m on Electric 80 plus 150 m on Diesel 120 is not a catalogue distance. Compare your measured line with one printed label.
body.zh: 电动80的 900 m 加上柴油120的 150 m 不是目录距离。用你量到的管路对照一个印出的标题。

body.en: None of the four pages prints a price. Ask [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) after the path is chosen.
body.zh: 四页都没有印价格。选定路径后询问 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

answer.en: The selection note says to start there, then compare the other three. It does not say to buy it when the motor cannot be fed.
answer.zh: 选型说明说先从那里开始，再比较另外三台。它没有说在电机供不上时仍然购买。

question.en: What does Electric 60 print for 24 mm stone?
question.zh: 电动60的 24 mm 石子印多少？

answer.en: 100 m / 300 m, beside fine-stone 200 m / 600 m.

question.en: Are HBT80-16 and LZ-80 on this shortlist?
question.zh: HBT80-16 和 LZ-80 在这份短名单上吗？

answer.en: The long-distance note names Electric 80, Electric 60, HBT8018 and Diesel 120. The other two pages exist, but they are not this sentence.
answer.zh: 长距离说明点名电动80、电动60、HBT8018 和柴油120。另外两页存在，但不在这句话里。
